quotes.text: What I'm trying to do is find a fish that'll live in my tank without a heater, that's the whole reason I'm here.
For me the test is whether I can find a compatible fish in under two minutes.
quotes.note: the participant's own criterion is a user need, not a success metric

quotes.text: They obviously want me on the premium plan before they'll even show me prices.
You can tell the whole page is built to get you to book a demo.
Honestly I'd come back to this every week if it stayed like this.
I gave up at the form, I'm not filling in all that just to see a price.
This doesn't feel like a real bank at all, it looks like a generic template.

There's no way to compare two fish side by side, I keep going back and forth.
They don't list water parameters for any of the fish.
The compatibility checker is the one thing that matters, everything else is nice to have.

quotes.text: I'd have expected angelfish under tropical freshwater, not just under 'fish'.
